title: Prediction of Intrinsically Disordered Regions That Bind RNA with DisoRDPbind.
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍预测RNA结合无序区域(DisoRDPbind)的工具，聚焦无序蛋白与RNA的互作预测，但方法为传统机器学习而非AI/物理模拟，且未深入互作机制建模，对本课题有参考价值但非核心方向。
abstract: A common cellular function of intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) is molecular binding, which covers interactions with various partner molecules, including proteins, peptides, nucleic acids, lipids, and small molecules. While there are many computational predictors of binding IDRs, relatively few target IDRs that bind RNAs. We focus on one of the first tools designed to predict RNA-binding IDRs: DisoRDPbind. DisoRDPbind is available as an easy-to-use web server at http://biomine.cs.vcu.edu/servers/DisoRDPbind/ . We describe the predictive model employed by DisoRDPbind and discuss its predictive performance and runtime, which were recently measured in the second CAID (Critical Assessment of protein Intrinsic Disorder) experiment. We highlight the small computational footprint of DisoRDPbind, which allows for large/proteome-scale predictions. We detail how to use the web server interface of DisoRDPbind and provide an example to illustrate how to read and interpret its prediction results. While DisoRDPbind does not identify RNA chaperones directly, we present a case study of an RNA chaperone, HCV core protein, to illustrate the method's utility in studying RNA chaperones.
abstract_zh: 内在无序区域（intrinsically disordered regions, IDRs）的一个常见细胞功能是分子结合，这涵盖与多种伙伴分子的相互作用，包括蛋白质、肽、核酸、脂质和小分子。虽然存在许多用于预测结合性IDRs的计算工具，但针对结合RNA的IDRs的工具相对较少。我们聚焦于最早设计用于预测RNA结合IDRs的工具之一：DisoRDPbind。DisoRDPbind可通过易于使用的网络服务器在 http://biomine.cs.vcu.edu/servers/DisoRDPbind/ 获取。我们描述了DisoRDPbind采用的预测模型，并讨论了其预测性能和运行时间，这些指标最近在第二次CAID（Critical Assessment of protein Intrinsic Disorder）实验中进行了测量。我们强调了DisoRDPbind的小计算开销，这使得其适用于大规模/蛋白质组规模的预测。我们详细说明了如何使用DisoRDPbind的网络服务器界面，并提供了一个示例来阐释如何读取和解释其预测结果。虽然DisoRDPbind不直接识别RNA伴侣（RNA chaperones），但我们通过一个RNA伴侣——HCV核心蛋白的案例研究，展示了该方法在研究RNA伴侣中的实用性。
